sloka: अहो तमैव इदम् स्यान् न प्रज्ञायेत किम्चन ।राजा चेन् न भवेन् लोके विभजन् साध्व् असाधुनी ॥२-६७-३६॥
transliteration: aho tamaiva idam syān na prajñāyeta kimcana ।rājā cen na bhaven loke vibhajan sādhv asādhunī ॥2-67-36॥

translations.english: If the king did not show the distinction between the good and evil actions, this world would have been enveloped by darkness. Nothing could have been seen. How great (is the king)?
